label: Elemental Light A
description: The original tiny floating light elemental: a small flattened oval dark blue-gray glassy sphere with a pale gold horizontal glowing center, surrounded by irregular clusters of fine sharp pale ivory and gold star-shaped sparkles. Preserve its small central sphere, exact particle positions, empty gaps, flickering white-gold light, subtle cool rim and restrained native glow. Attack frames develop a larger orange-gold circular flare and luminous center. Death frames scatter into separate dim warm gray-brown motes and a few fading gold sparks. No humanoid face, eyes, limbs, wings, ornaments, opaque cloud, giant sun or extra broad bloom. Keep the diffuse light soft and translucent-looking, with crisp tiny sparkle cores and native relative brightness. Preserve every disconnected particle and each frame-specific silhouette.
